name: nvjpeg_ycbcr_to_rgb_420
desc: nvjpeg::ycbcr_to_format_kernel_roi<420(2),false,RGB(3),LaunchParams<32,8>> from libnvjpeg sm_90. YCbCr 4:2:0 -> planar RGB (same FFMA conversion math as the BGR variant, output plane order R,G,B). Output uint8 derived from FP; compared with +/-1 TOLERANCE (cmp_u8_tol) so a 1-ULP rounding difference between the lifted FP and the host fmaf reference is allowed. Demonstrates FP-tolerant verification.
ground_truth: x86-lifted vs host fmaf reference, +/-1 tol: 0/384, TEST PASSED
